open_points.subject: _project_budget_sections
open_points.text: - _project_budget_sections: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST emit one BudgetSectionView per plan with stable section identity/name/order, unclamped remaining, progress, completed work, and unresolved flag, and MUST derive material_actual for a plan's section from section-targeted allocations of included expenses only. An expense whose included is false contributes nothing to material_actual and therefore nothing to material_remaining; the helper applies that filter itself and does not rely on a caller having applied it, because the same projection is reachable from any caller and an excluded expense counted here reports a material budget as spent that is not.
open_points.other_text: - _project_budget_sections: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] For a plan whose section has no progress row, MUST emit completion_percent None and completed_work_value Decimal zero; completed_work_value is a required Decimal and never None. Every other emitted field is a required Decimal too, so material_actual and material_remaining are Decimal zero when nothing is allocated rather than None.
open_points.question: Must material_remaining be the unclamped remaining material budget (and therefore equal material_planned when material_actual is zero), or must it be Decimal zero when nothing is allocated?
